verdict.rationale: A government business-registry service could plausibly publish a machine channel with an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary, so this axis applies. The evidence pack describes only online web applications, forms, email and text notices, fax filing and PBS accounts. Nothing in it shows a published machine-readable specification for any API or bulk data channel.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
